name: Airfocus
description: Airfocus is Lucid's product-intelligence platform for connecting customer signals, strategy, OKRs, prioritization, roadmaps and delivery context. Product organizations use flexible workspaces and items to make traceable decisions and coordinate portfolios across teams.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Airfocus Enterprise personal access token and fixed EU or US region. Selected agents can use seven bounded workspace and item actions under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; administration, advanced fields, collaboration, raw API access and exports remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRFOCUS_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Airfocus personal access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated Airfocus personal access token with workspace read/write scope, created by the intended least-authority user.

credentialRequirements.name: AIRFOCUS_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Airfocus data region
credentialRequirements.helpText: The fixed Airfocus API region: eu or us.

capabilities.label: Read workspaces
capabilities.description: List bounded visible workspaces and inspect one exact workspace.

capabilities.label: Read workspace items
capabilities.description: List and inspect metadata-only items inside one exact workspace.

capabilities.label: Manage workspace items
capabilities.description: Create minimal items, collision-safely rename/archive them and name-confirm deletion.

approvalRequired.label: List workspaces
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded workspace summaries visible to the token user.

approvalRequired.label: Read workspace
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact Airfocus workspace UUID.

approvalRequired.label: List workspace items
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty metadata-only items from one exact workspace.

approvalRequired.label: Read item
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded metadata for one exact item in one exact workspace.

approvalRequired.label: Create item
approvalRequired.description: Create one minimal unarchived item with a bounded name.

approvalRequired.label: Update item
approvalRequired.description: Change only an exact item's bounded name or archived state after its current name matches.

approvalRequired.label: Delete item
approvalRequired.description: Permanently delete one exact item only after its current name matches the supplied confirmation.

blocked.label: Administer workspaces
blocked.description: Workspace creation, settings, statuses, permissions, duplication, deletion and administrator elevation are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change advanced item data
blocked.description: Descriptions, custom fields, status, assignees, colors, ordering, integrations and arbitrary JSON Patch paths are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change collaboration data
blocked.description: Comments, watchers, attachments, links, hierarchy relations and link types are unavailable.

blocked.label: Manage team or profile
blocked.description: Members, groups, roles, profile, notification settings, AI actors and templates are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary Airfocus calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose API origins, paths, filters, request bodies, media types or raw REST operations.

blocked.label: Run bulk or global operations
blocked.description: Bulk, cross-workspace, alias, analytics, copy, move and global-search operations are unavailable.

blocked.label: Export Airfocus data
blocked.description: Twenty-row lists, one exact resource and 256 KiB responses are the maximum supported surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Private reads and every item mutation require approval. Fixed region, inherited user authority, exact UUIDs, bounds, confirmation and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All seven selected Airfocus actions run without Relay per-action approval; fixed region, token authority, bounds, field allowlists, confirmation, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway executes seven fixed Airfocus REST actions at the selected documented EU or US origin with exact UUIDs, minimal mutations, confirmation, bounds and redaction.
Railway executes seven fixed Airfocus REST actions at the selected documented EU or US origin with exact UUIDs, minimal mutations, confirmation, bounds and redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: Airfocus public REST API access requires an Enterprise subscription and a personal access token created by a user with the required workspace scopes and workspace permissions in the separate provider-console acceptance task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console acceptance task, use a synthetic Enterprise account, create a dedicated least-authority user and separate scoped token, enter the token and fixed region in Relay, verify the seven bounded tools, then revoke the token.

evidence.supports: Lucid documents Enterprise-only Airfocus API access and personal API-key creation from member settings.
The official OpenAPI documentation confirms Bearer personal-access-token authentication, EU and US origins, workspace scopes, fixed workspace/item endpoints, pagination and rate limits.
Airfocus lists open API access with its Enterprise offering.
Airfocus describes its product-intelligence workflow across feedback, strategy, OKRs, roadmaps and delivery.
